note: Seventh straight quiet week for admin moves - no hires, exits, or board personnel actions turned up dated within the past 7 days across any of the fifteen districts and trusts. The one substantive item was LaPorte's board financing its Kiwanis Stadium restoration. Last week's Nov. 3 referendum results (Tri-Creek and Union Township passed, Michigan City failed) are now outside the 7-day window and aren't repeated here.

stories.headline: LaPorte board approves bond financing and Kiwanis Stadium design work
stories.body: The board reapproved the LaPorte Multi-School Building Corporation and authorized an initial roughly $50 million bond issuance for district-wide capital improvements, plus a letter of intent with Schmidt Associates for architectural and engineering design on the $12 million Kiwanis Stadium restoration. Superintendent Dr. Sandra Wood was authorized to sign the letter of intent.
